decisions.title: Spotlight Layout for Final Desktop Welcome

lessons_next: Fast-track adoption flows effectively improved onboarding metrics.
Reordering sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and won.
Spotlight layout changes on the final desktop welcome screen showed no clear effect.
Background rendering notification prompts showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated the actual measured uplift across all tests.
